question:
Find the value of x.

{1}{(1)/(5)} – {3}{(2)/(4)} div {1}{(3)/(4)} div (x + {3}{(1)/(8)} ) div {1}{(1)/(7)} = 1
solution:
**Calculation:**

From the given expression, we can defined the range of x:

x ≠ - (25/8)

Convert the mixed fraction into improper fraction:

(6)/(5) - (14)/(5) ÷(7)/(4) ÷(x+(25)/(8)) ÷ (8)/(7)=1 

Convert division into multiplication by reciprocate the fraction,

(6)/(5) - (14)/(5) .(4)/(7) ÷(x+(25)/(8)) . (7)/(8)=1
